roleContext.jobDescription: We are a digital bank offering current accounts and small-business lending. The Financial Crime Investigations Team Leader supervises six investigators who review transaction-monitoring alerts escalated by the first-line team, quality-checks investigation decisions, drafts suspicious activity reports for the nominated officer's approval and trains new investigators. The role needs the CAMS certification and at least five years of anti-money-laundering investigation work, and the team leader reports to the head of financial crime operations and joins the monthly meeting with the nominated officer on open cases.

requirements.text: Supervises a team of investigators reviewing escalated transaction-monitoring alerts.
Holds the Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) certification.
Has at least five years of anti-money-laundering investigation experience.
Quality-checks investigation decisions and drafts suspicious activity reports for the nominated officer.
Designs and delivers training for new investigators.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Financial Crime Investigations Team Leader

## Experience

- Investigations Team Leader, Tamworth & Lyle Bank (June 2023 to September 2026): supervised the alert queue of a five-person investigation pod, allocating escalated alerts each morning and reviewing every closure decision before it was filed.
- Drafted suspicious activity reports for the nominated officer's approval and kept the quality-check log recording the reviewer, the outcome and any rework for each case.
- Investigator, Calder Building Society (April 2019 to May 2023): investigated alerts on personal accounts, including mule-account patterns and third-party cash deposits.
- CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), awarded by ACAMS in November 2021, member ID 7740215.
- Delivered the two-day induction on alert investigation to the investigators who joined in 2025, using the materials prepared by the compliance training team.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised quality-check log for one month, showing 42 closed investigations, the reviewer for each, the outcome category and the three cases returned for rework with the reasons.
